rationale.overall: B's lighter charcoal treatment is closer to the reference's overall tonal and dimensional read than A's near-black appearance.
rationale.material: B better suggests the reference's softly lit charcoal material, while A reads more like dark glossy plastic.
rationale.silhouette: The two takes use effectively identical geometry and preserve the same rounded rectangular form and curled strip.
rationale.smallsize: A's stronger dark-to-light contrast and clearer orange edge remain more legible at 32px and 16px.
